claims.text: A binary classifier was trained to identify publications that met specific criteria, performing better when trained on relevant sentences than on randomly selected sentences.
The classifier utilized a Bernoulli Naïve Bayes model trained on binary occurrence matrices created from n-grams extracted from the publications.
The classifier's performance was evaluated using existing 0/1 labels available in the database to determine if publications met the given criteria.
